Requirement ID Category Non-functional requirement Information about the governance and restricted use of data SHOULD be available within any solution alongside the data concerned, so that users have a clear and DDCC.NFXNREQ.031 Security and privacy consistent reminder of the level of confidentiality, sensitivity and the permitted use of the data they are currently viewing. Dashboards, reports, standard queries and exports of security information DDCC.NFXNREQ.032 Security and privacy SHOULD be provided to assist system administrators in the management of access permissions. Queries to highlight conflicting permissions SHOULD be available. The confidentiality of data must be managed with utmost care. In shared data environments, there SHALL be a clear separation of between the system’s data DDCC.NFXNREQ.033 Security and privacy and any other hosted clients’ information. Dedicated hosting and data sources are preferred. Any solution SHOULD be designed to be mindful of existing reference architecture Regulation and DDCC.NFXNREQ.034 guidelines and standards for distributed trust framework solutions and tools for compliance exchanging vaccination data. Regulation and Any solution SHALL be compliant with any data policies and legal requirements DDCC.NFXNREQ.035 compliance identified by the country in whose jurisdiction the solution will operate. It MAY be possible to tag data sets with any regulation and compliance information Regulation and relevant to them so that this is readily available with the data set. Such information DDCC.NFXNREQ.036 compliance might include the data provider, intended purpose of the data, restrictions on the use of the data, and restrictions on where data can be stored. Any solution SHALL be compliant with any data storage, retention and destruction Regulation and DDCC.NFXNREQ.037 laws mandated by the data policies and data laws of the countries in which data are compliance located. Any solution SHOULD be designed to maximize the mean time between failures, with DDCC.NFXNREQ.038 Reliability appropriate best practice to deliver a robust, well-tested and reliable platform. Any solution SHOULD provide a log, in which failures in any part of the system are DDCC.NFXNREQ.039 Reliability logged, so that mean time between failures can be calculated and tracked. Any solution SHOULD be designed so that elements can be scaled horizontally by, for example, adding extra resources (more servers, extra virtual machines, etc.) and the DDCC.NFXNREQ.040 Scalability mechanisms for coordinating their activity (load balancing, session management, etc.) Any solution SHOULD be designed so that elements can be scaled vertically by, for DDCC.NFXNREQ.041 Scalability example, adding extra capacity to solution elements (increased CPU, increased RAM, etc.) It MAY be possible to configure rules for automatic horizontal scaling of the system to respond to increased load (e.g. spinning up a new virtual machine and adding it to DDCC.NFXNREQ.042 Scalability a load-balanced pool of resources). Rules will be based on thresholds for system load and performance. Any solution SHOULD log sufficient information about performance and load so that DDCC.NFXNREQ.043 Scalability technical staff can refine the system’s scaling strategy based on actual usage. Any solution SHOULD provide a feedback channel as described in functional DDCC.NFXNREQ.044 Supportability requirements for collecting information and support requests. Any solution MAY provide access to learning material to support a user’s DDCC.NFXNREQ.045 Supportability understanding of how to use the tool and achieve specific aims. The solution SHALL include a system log of activity in which events of interest, the time and date when they occur, their categorization, and the user (if appropriate) DDCC.NFXNREQ.046 Supportability who triggered the event are recorded. The log must be of sufficient detail to assist technical staff with debugging issues.
